ability to buy 100 eggs at a time and ability to autorejoin to find nullity & buy every egg in the shop automatically,

To use Nullity Spam Join you need to open the settings tab and create a new Config, then set that config to be Auto Loading, then add this script into AutoExecute

Indepth Description of Auto Nullity

1. click on settings

2. scroll down to configuration

3. type in a config name

4. click create config

5. select newly created config from config list

6. click "Set as autoload"

7. place script into auto execute folder

8. toggle autonullity

NEW FEATURE!!!

Auto Weather, just like autonullity, but you can find specific weathers
